name: walletkit-web
description: WalletKit enables users to hold credentials and prove their humanity with World ID .

scripts.generate: bun run patch:generator && ubrn build wasm2 --config ubrn.config.yaml --release && node scripts/optimize-wasm.mjs && node scripts/patch-generated-index.mjs
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@ubjs/core --external:@ubjs/wasm && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
